title: Large Language Models for Biomedical Article Classification

live_model.evidence: Sec. 3.10: 'gptna: the best variant ... with the GPT-4.1 nano model (version: gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14)'; Table 11 column gptna, row Avg 0.439 (AUPRC)

prompt.location: Appendix A, Tables 12-14 (prompt templates); Table 14 few-shot prompt B used for the final comparison
prompt.note: 3-shot examples are selected per abstract by L2 similarity in all-distilroberta-v1 embedding space; class probabilities from top-20 token logprobs.

data.source: DCR drug-class systematic review datasets (Cohen et al. 2006), abstracts from PubMed; Table 2 sizes

notes: GPT-4 Turbo appears only in related work (role C). Temperature 0; needs logprobs and embedding-based example retrieval.

resolution.plan: Table 14 prompt B has {topic} and {text} slots plus three example slots; fill the examples per abstract with the three L2-nearest training abstracts in all-distilroberta-v1 embedding space from the training folds of a stratified 5-fold CV (Sec. 3.7-3.8), using PubMed abstracts fetched by the DCR PMIDs. Run gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 at temperature 0 with the JSON-prefixed assistant message, derive class probabilities from the top-20 first-token logprobs, and compute AUPRC per DCR dataset, macro-averaged over the 15 datasets (0.439).
resolution.approximation: CV fold seed differs; some PubMed abstracts may be missing or revised; about 49k calls.
